title: Find every unauthenticated route and the name of the webhook secret across 200 modules
spec:
OBJECTIVE
This service registers 200 HTTP handlers. Every handler is supposed to be wrapped with the require_auth decorator. Answer two questions exactly, by reading the code, not by guessing from names: (1) Which route paths are registered WITHOUT require_auth? List every one and no others. (2) What is the exact name of the environment variable that holds the webhook signing secret? Trace the real definition, not an alias.

FILES
src/svc/ (read-only; do not modify anything)

INTERFACES
Final message: a line starting with UNAUTHENTICATED: followed by the route paths, comma separated; then a line starting with SECRET_ENV: followed by the variable name. Nothing else is graded.

CONSTRAINTS
A route listed that is actually protected counts against you. An alias name instead of the environment variable name counts as wrong.

VERIFY
n/a (read-only task)

REASONING
as invoked
